links.note: AB = AC is written out as (x+2)^2+(y-3)^2 = (x-2)^2+(y-1)^2 and simplified to y = 2x+2. The whole derivation is two applications of the distance formula set equal.

Three given corner coordinates fix the fourth at (8,7), and the 3-by-2 extent and 6 sq ft area are read off the same ordered pairs. It is reasoning directly with points' (x,y) coordinates; no distance formula is needed.
AD = 5, DM = root 29 and MA = root 40, each from the square root of the squared coordinate differences. Three applications of the distance formula, left in exact form.

Reflection in the y-axis flips the signs of the x-coordinates while side lengths, perimeter and area are unchanged - exactly this concept's 'changes the sign of the corresponding coordinate while preserving distance'.
